description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to sharing a buzz post within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and encapsulates a post ID as the filtering criterion.

classes.name: BuzzPostShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filtering parameters when searching for shared buzz posts, including post ID.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Returns the post ID used as a filter criterion, or null if not set.

methods.name: setPostId
methods.description: Sets the post ID filter criterion.
